Display rich prose, documentation runbooks, image galleries, and playable media inside any @aiui.page or declarative YAML page.

Python builder YAML type What it renders aiui.text(content) text Plain paragraph text aiui.markdown_text(content) markdown_text Sanitized Markdown (tables, code blocks, links, lists) aiui.doc_viewer(content, *, title, toc=True) doc_viewer Full Markdown document reader with automatic Table of Contents aiui.image_display(src, *, alt, caption, width) image_display Single responsive image with optional caption aiui.gallery(items) gallery Responsive thumbnail grid (src, alt, caption, optional click link) aiui.audio_player(src, *, autoplay=False, title) audio_player Built-in HTML5 audio player aiui.video_player(src, *, autoplay=False, poster, title) video_player Built-in HTML5 video player with poster image aiui.html(content) / aiui.html_embed(content) html / html_embed Trusted HTML snippet container
In YAML pages, pointing markdown_file: to any local .md file renders it through doc_viewer automatically and reloads edits dynamically on the next page fetch without restarting the server.
